in_marathi.name: Arjyak
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Righteous, Just, Pure
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arjyak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arjyak is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arj’ meaning righteous, and ‘yak’ meaning just or pure. This name is given to a boy signifying that he will be virtuous, honest, and just in his actions.
